title: Phase information beyond entanglement sudden death in coherence-to-entanglement conversion under post-gate noise
summary: An ideal CNOT maps the phase of a coherent qubit onto the coherence between $\ket{00}$ and $\ket{11}$ of a two-qubit state, producing an output that carries both entanglement and estimable phase information. We ask how post-gate noise degrades these two quantities, and find that they are not lost together.
